configuration.warmup_policy: Sequential per sample; each sample receives the requested warmup count and all must pass
configuration.latency_scope: HTTP transfer, decoding and protocol validation; excludes client queue time
configuration.http_scope: Client urlopen through full response-body read; includes network, server queue, processing and serialization
configuration.json_decode_scope: UTF-8 response text conversion and JSON parsing
configuration.client_queue_scope: executor.submit timestamp through worker function entry; separately reported from elapsed_ms
configuration.server_queue_scope: Unavailable in client-only timing; correlate client_request_id with server telemetry
configuration.concurrency_scope: ThreadPoolExecutor max workers bounds active HTTP requests; observed peak excludes queued futures
configuration.throughput_window: First submission through completion of all measured requests; excludes warmup
configuration.sample_selection: Measured requests round-robin in sample-file order; each sample prewarmed separately
